profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer | AUTOSAR | UDS | MCAL | I/O Hw configuration | Python | Rust for Embedded Systems | SAFe Framework - Product Owner | C/C++ Coding
profile.summary:
Mechatronics Engineer with a Master’s degree in Electronics Engineering and over 7 years of experience as an Embedded Software Engineer in the automotive industry. Known for being detail-oriented, innovative, and committed to delivering high-quality software solutions for electric vehicles (EVs), braking and steering systems, and Battery Management Systems (BMS).

Proficient in C/C++, RTOS, MATLAB/Simulink, Auto Code Generation, and AUTOSAR. Skilled in diagnostics, controller communication, and working with CAN/CANFD protocols. I bring a strong understanding of the V-Model and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), along with a collaborative mindset and solid problem-solving skills.

I’m passionate about continuous learning, staying current with industry trends, and embracing new challenges that drive growth and innovation in embedded systems.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed software components for various products.
•	Configured, generated code, and developed MCAL for ADC, I/O, memory, and communication drivers.
•	Set up memory and communication stacks using diverse toolsets.
•	Implemented wrapper functions to adapt memory components across AUTOSAR versions.
•	Software development life cycle (SDLC)
•	Managed development using version control tools.
•	Led debugging and validation of HSI for various components and memory layouts.
•	Used testing tools to validate diagnostic commands in the system.
•	Held architecture discussions with team members to define expected behavior and component outputs.
•	Authored and reviewed software, safety, and test requirements.

positions.title: Embedded Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed, tested, and executed diagnostic services per customer specs for 48V BMS, ensuring 100% implementation in each sprint.
•	Analyzed and authored customer requirements, breaking them down into software, high-level, and low-level designs to maintain full traceability.
•	Developed and validated CAN Tx/Rx messages and interfaces, verifying correct signal behavior in application layers.
•	Evaluated MISRA warnings to prevent violations and ensure proper functionality of software changes.
•	Prepared documentation for internal ASPICE audits, ensuring 90% process adherence.
•	Used ETAS INCA for feature verification in BMS project.
•	Developed and tested freeze frames for UDS, created new DIDs, and configured memory to store BMS signal data.
•	Built and assessed new features in HiL using LabCar and tools from Vector and Bosch.
•	Followed Agile Scrum to track backlog and sprint tasks via JIRA and ALM.
•	Conducted AUTOSAR module training for interns and junior engineers.
•	Led meetings to address team queries on development, bug fixing, and deliverables.
•	Met with customers to discuss developments, sharing data on implementation impacts.
•	Programmed in C/C++ for new features and migrations in active safety projects.
Evaluated errata and MISRA warnings to ensure compliance with MISRA C standards.
